details: US President Donald Trump announced expectations of a "very big" agreement with Russia that could extend beyond Ukraine to involve all of Europe, but provided no specifics. This announcement, despite ongoing peace talks and sanctions discussions, led to market uncertainty, causing Bitcoin and other tech assets to fall sharply. Upcoming talks in Abu Dhabi and a Ukraine Defense Contact Group meeting are anticipated to clarify the deal's potential impact on energy prices, sanctions, and European crypto markets.
title: Trump Hints at "Very Big" Russia-Europe Deal, Bitcoin Dips

details: Bitcoin experienced a downward pull following the release of stronger-than-expected US employment figures for October. A robust jobs report suggests the US economy remains strong, which can lead to the Federal Reserve keeping benchmark interest rates higher for longer to control inflation. This outlook makes conservative yield-bearing assets more attractive, reducing buying pressure on speculative assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Strong US Jobs Report Pushes Bitcoin Down

details: The cryptocurrency market has taken a significant hit, with Bitcoin crashing over 6% in the last 24 hours, slipping towards the $75,000 mark. This decline is largely attributed to growing concerns in global financial markets, particularly a sharp fall in US technology and AI stocks. The Nasdaq Composite's substantial drop fueled a broader shift away from risky investments, leading to over $1 billion in crypto liquidations.
title: Global Tech and AI Stock Sell-off Triggers Crypto Crash

details: Bitcoin initially slid to a seven-week low as US midterm results showed Democrats winning control of both the House and Senate. However, it quickly recovered, climbing back above US$80,000 as stocks rallied on the results. Experts are divided on whether the outcome was already priced in, but a Democratic Congress working with a Republican president is seen by some as potentially leading to gridlock, which could mean fewer policy surprises for Bitcoin.
title: US Midterm Election Results Impact Crypto Volatility
